IT Support Specialist
Webflow | San Francisco, CA

About Webflow
Webflow is a Website Experience Platform that empowers modern marketing
teams to build, manage and optimize sites without writing code. We are a
remote-first company with a culture built on warmth, curiosity and a bias
toward action. Our people bring flexibility and warmth to everything they
do, and we take ownership of our outcomes together.

What you'll do
- Resolve employee tickets through our help desk ticketing system, owning
  each issue from first response to closure.
- Diagnose hardware and software issues across macOS and Windows 11
  laptops, escalating where needed.
- Maintain hardware and software inventory, tracking every device through
  its lifecycle.
- Handle IT onboarding for new hires: provision laptops, create accounts
  and grant system access on day one.
- Support meeting rooms, including presentation equipment, audiovisual
  setup and Zoom Rooms hardware.
- Use AI-powered support tools to triage and route incoming requests.
- Take ownership of recurring problems and drive them to a root cause.

What you'll bring
- 2+ years in an IT support or help desk role.
- Strong macOS troubleshooting skills; Windows 11 and Google Workspace
  administration experience.
- Excellent communication and attention to detail when working with
  non-technical colleagues.
- Experience with Jamf or a comparable device management platform.

Nice to have
- Scripting experience in Python or Bash.
- Exposure to Okta, Slack administration or ServiceNow.

Working arrangements
- This role is physical office work, onsite five days per week in our San
  Francisco office.
- Must be able to lift up to 50lbs of equipment.

Benefits
- Equity ownership in Webflow through our employee stock option plan.
- A generous annual training budget and access to a mentorship programme.
- Benefits administration handled for you, including medical, dental and
  vision from day one.
- Flexible paid time off and a home office stipend.

Webflow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the
basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual
orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.
